function regionalMedicalFeedUrl(query) {
  return 'https://api.rss2json.com/v1/api.json?rss_url=' +
    encodeURIComponent(
      'https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=' +
      encodeURIComponent(query) +
      '&hl=en&gl=QA&ceid=QA:en'
    );
}

function isBoringInstitutionalHealthHeadline(title) {
  const value = String(title || '').toLowerCase();
  return (
    /\b(publications?|homepage|portal|newsletter|annual report|media center|media centre)\b/i.test(value) ||
    /\b(latest|new)\s+(health|public health|primary care)?\s*updates?\b/i.test(value) ||
    /\bministry of public health\s*[-–:]?\s*publications?\b/i.test(value) ||
    /\bphcc\s*[-–:]?\s*(latest|updates?|publications?)\b/i.test(value)
  );
}

function isRelevantFamilyMedicineHeadline(title, sourceName) {
  const t=String(title||'').toLowerCase().trim(), s=String(sourceName||'').toLowerCase();
  if(!t||/publications?|newsletter|latest updates?|homepage|minister meets|conference to open/i.test(t)) return false;
  const topic=/(family medicine|primary care|general practice|randomized|trial|meta-analysis|guideline|glp-1|semaglutide|tirzepatide|obesity|diabetes|hypertension|cardiovascular|screening|vaccine|measles|influenza|antibiotic|antimicrobial|mental health|cancer|microbiome|dementia|asthma|copd|smoking|prevention)/i;
  const trusted=/(jama|nejm|lancet|bmj|nature|annals|medscape|who|cdc|fda|sidra|hamad)/i;
  return topic.test(t)&&(trusted.test(t)||trusted.test(s));
}

function cleanInterestingMedicalTickerText(title, sourceName) {
  return cleanRegionalMedicalHeadline(title, sourceName);
}

async function fetchRegionalMedicalSource(source) {
  try {
    const items = await fetchRssJson(regionalMedicalFeedUrl(source.query));

    return items
      .map(function(item) {
        return {
          title: normalizeFeedTitle(item.title),
          link: String(item.link || item.url || source.home || ''),
          sourceName: source.name,
          domain: source.domain,
          priority: source.priority || 1
        };
      })
      .filter(function(item) {
        return item.title &&
          item.title.length > 18 &&
          isRelevantFamilyMedicineHeadline(item.title, item.sourceName);
      })
      .map(function(item) {
        item.title = cleanInterestingMedicalTickerText(item.title, item.sourceName);
        return item;
      })
      .slice(0,6);
  } catch (e) {
    return [];
  }
}

function cleanRegionalMedicalHeadline(title, sourceName) {
  let value = String(title || '')
    .replace(/\s+-\s+Google News\s*$/i, '')
    .replace(/\s+-\s+[^-]{2,45}$/i, function(match) {
      const source = String(sourceName || '').toLowerCase();
      const tail = match.toLowerCase();
      return tail.includes(source.split(' ')[0]) ? '' : match;
    })
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim();
  return fitNormalTickerCopy(value, 15, 108);
}


async function fetchRotasticNewsProxy(kind) {
  try {
    const response = await fetch(
      ROTASTIC_NEWS_PROXY_ENDPOINT + '?kind=' + encodeURIComponent(kind || 'medical'),
      {headers:{'Accept':'application/json'}}
    );
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error('ROTASTIC news proxy request failed');
    const payload = await response.json();
    return Array.isArray(payload.items) ? payload.items : [];
  } catch (e) {
    return [];
  }
}

function chooseNiceGuidanceTickerItem() {
  const item = ROTASTIC_NICE_GUIDANCE_UPDATES[Math.floor(Math.random() * ROTASTIC_NICE_GUIDANCE_UPDATES.length)];
  if (!item) return '';
  rotasticCurrentMedicalSourceMeta = {name:'NICE', domain:'nice.org.uk'};
  rotasticCurrentMedicalLink = item.link || 'https://www.nice.org.uk/';
  return makeShortMedicalHeadline(item.title, 'NICE') || '';
}

  }));

    const key = String(item.link || '') + '|' + String(item.title || '');

  {
    title:'NICE 2026: Type 2 diabetes — metformin + SGLT2 for many adults.',
    sourceName:'NICE',
    domain:'nice.org.uk',
    link:'https://www.nice.org.uk/guidance/ng28/chapter/initial-medicines',
    priority:12
  },

    title:'NICE 2026: T2 diabetes + obesity — consider GLP-1 or tirzepatide.',
    sourceName:'NICE',
    domain:'nice.org.uk',
    link:'https://www.nice.org.uk/guidance/ng28/chapter/Further-medication',
    priority:12
  },
  {
    title:'NICE: Hypertension work-up includes ACR, HbA1c, renal tests and lipids.',
    sourceName:'NICE',
    domain:'nice.org.uk',
    link:'https://www.nice.org.uk/guidance/ng136/chapter/recommendations',
    priority:11
  },
  {
    title:'NICE 2026: Diabetes care should include cardiovascular and renal protection.',
    sourceName:'NICE',
    domain:'nice.org.uk',
    link:'https://www.nice.org.uk/guidance/ng28/chapter/person-centred-medicine',
    priority:11
  },
  {
    title:'NICE: Separate sepsis guidance now covers adults, children and pregnancy.',
    sourceName:'NICE',
    domain:'nice.org.uk',
    link:'https://www.nice.org.uk/guidance/published?ngt=Clinical+guidelines&sp=on',
    priority:9
  }

function chooseNiceGuidanceTickerItem() {
  const item = ROTASTIC_NICE_GUIDANCE_UPDATES[Math.floor(Math.random() * ROTASTIC_NICE_GUIDANCE_UPDATES.length)];
  if (!item) return '';
  rotasticCurrentMedicalSourceMeta = {name:'NICE', domain:'nice.org.uk'};
  rotasticCurrentMedicalLink = item.link || 'https://www.nice.org.uk/';
  return makeShortMedicalHeadline(item.title, 'NICE') || '';
}

function mergeNiceGuidanceIntoMedicalHeadlines(items) {
  const current = Array.isArray(items) ? items.slice() : [];
  const seen = new Set(current.map(function(item) {
    return String(item && item.link || '') + '|' + String(item && item.title || '');
  }));

  ROTASTIC_NICE_GUIDANCE_UPDATES.forEach(function(item) {
    const key = String(item.link || '') + '|' + String(item.title || '');
    if (!seen.has(key)) {
      current.push(Object.assign({}, item));
      seen.add(key);
    }
  });

  return current
    .filter(function(item) { return item && item.title; })
    .sort(function(a,b) { return Number(b.priority || 0) - Number(a.priority || 0); });
}

const ROTASTIC_MEDICAL_SOURCE_FALLBACKS = [
  {
    title:'Sidra Medicine • Paediatric endocrine, diabetes and child-health update',
    sourceName:'Sidra Medicine',
    domain:'sidra.org',
    link:'https://www.sidra.org/',
    priority:12
  },
  {
    title:'Hamad Medical Corporation • Clinical update relevant to family medicine',
    sourceName:'Hamad Medical Corporation',
    domain:'hamad.qa',
    link:'https://www.hamad.qa/',
    priority:11

    link:'https://www.nice.org.uk/guidance/published',
    priority:9
  }
];

async function refreshExternalHeadlineFeeds() {
  const now = Date.now();
  if (now - rotasticExternalNewsFetchedAt < 6 * 60 * 1000) return;
  rotasticExternalNewsFetchedAt = now;

  const medicalEndpoint =
    window.ROTASTIC_MEDICAL_NEWS_ENDPOINT ||
    'https://api.rss2json.com/v1/api.json?rss_url=' +
      encodeURIComponent('https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=medicine+OR+medical+research+when:2d&hl=en-GB&gl=GB&ceid=GB:en');

      encodeURIComponent(
        'https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=site%3Aaljazeera.com+when%3A1d&hl=en&gl=QA&ceid=QA%3Aen'
      );

  const alJazeeraDirectEndpoint =
    'https://api.rss2json.com/v1/api.json?rss_url=' +
      encodeURIComponent('https://www.aljazeera.com/xml/rss/all.xml');

  const alArabiyaEndpoint='https://api.rss2json.com/v1/api.json?rss_url='+encodeURIComponent('https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=site%3Aenglish.alarabiya.net+when%3A2d&hl=en&gl=QA&ceid=QA%3Aen');

  const qnaEndpoint =
    window.ROTASTIC_QNA_ENDPOINT ||

f (now - rotasticExternalNewsFetchedAt < 6 * 60 * 1000) return;
  rotasticExternalNewsFetchedAt = now;

      encodeURIComponent('https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=medicine+OR+medical+research+when:2d&hl=en-GB&gl=GB&ceid=GB:en');

  const alJazeeraEndpoint =
    window.ROTASTIC_ALJAZEERA_ENDPOINT ||
    'https://api.rss2json.com/v1/api.json?rss_url=' +
      encodeURIComponent(
        'https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=site%3Aaljazeera.com+when%3A1d&hl=en&gl=QA&ceid=QA%3Aen'
      );

  const alJazeeraDirectEndpoint =
    'https://api.rss2json.com/v1/api.json?rss_url=' +
      encodeURIComponent('https://www.aljazeera.com/xml/rss/all.xml');

  const alArabiyaEndpoint='https://api.rss2json.com/v1/api.json?rss_url='+encodeURIComponent('https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=site%3Aenglish.alarabiya.net+when%3A2d&hl=en&gl=QA&ceid=QA%3Aen');

  const qnaEndpoint =

      encodeURIComponent(
        'https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=site%3Aqna.org.qa+when%3A2d&hl=en&gl=QA&ceid=QA%3Aen'
      );

  const reutersEndpoint =
    window.ROTASTIC_REUTERS_ENDPOINT ||
    'https://api.rss2json.com/v1/api.json?rss_url=' +
      encodeURIComponent(
        'https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=site%3Areuters.com+(Qatar+OR+Gulf+OR+Middle+East+OR+health)+when%3A2d&hl=en&gl=QA&ceid=QA%3Aen'
      );

  const nhsEndpoint =
    window.ROTASTIC_NHS_ENDPOINT ||
    'https://api.rss2json.com/v1/api.json?rss_url=' +
      encodeURIComponent(
        'https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=site%3Anhs.uk+(guidance+OR+evidence+OR+study+OR+screening+OR+diabetes+OR+hypertension+OR+obesity+OR+antibiotics+OR+vaccination+OR+treatment)+when%3A30d&hl=en&gl=GB&ceid=GB%3Aen'
      );

  try {
    const proxyItems = await fetchRotasticNewsProxy('medical');

    if (proxyItems.length) {
      rotasticRegionalMedicalHeadlines = proxyItems
        .map(function(item) {
          return {
            title:normalizeFeedTitle(item.title),
            link:String(item.link || ''),
            sourceName:String(item.sourceName || 'Medical News'),
            domain:String(item.domain || 'news.google.com'),
            priority:Number(item.priority || 1)
          };
        })
        .filter(function(item){ return item.title && isRelevantFamilyMedicineHeadline(item.title, item.sourceName); })
        .map(function(item) {
          item.title = cleanInterestingMedicalTickerText(item.title, item.sourceName);
          return item;
        })
        .slice(0,50);
    } else {
      const results = await Promise.all(
        ROTASTIC_REGIONAL_MEDICAL_SOURCES.map(fetchRegionalMedicalSource)
      );

      rotasticRegionalMedicalHeadlines = results
        .flat()
        .filter(function(item) {
          return isRelevantFamilyMedicineHeadline(item.title, item.sourceName);
        })
        .sort(function(a,b) {
          return (b.priority || 0) - (a.priority || 0);
        })
        .slice(0,40);
    }

    if (rotasticRegionalMedicalHeadlines.length) {
      Storage.setJSON(
        'rotastic_cached_regional_medical_headlines',
        rotasticRegionalMedicalHeadlines
      );
    } else {
      rotasticRegionalMedicalHeadlines =
        (Storage.getJSON('rotastic_cached_regional_medical_headlines', []) || []).filter(function(item) {
          return item && item.title && isRelevantFamilyMedicineHeadline(item.title, item.sourceName);
        });
    }
  } catch (e) {
    rotasticRegionalMedicalHeadlines =
      (Storage.getJSON('rotastic_cached_regional_medical_headlines', []) || []).filter(function(item) {
        return item && item.title && isRelevantFamilyMedicineHeadline(item.title, item.sourceName);
      });
  }

  rotasticRegionalMedicalHeadlines = mergeNiceGuidanceIntoMedicalHeadlines(
    rotasticRegionalMedicalHeadlines
  ).slice(0,50);

  // The same backend proxy provides reliable QNA / Al Jazeera current headlines.
  try {
    const currentItems = await fetchRotasticNewsProxy('current');
    if (currentItems.length) {
      const qnaProxy = currentItems
        .filter(function(x){ return /Qatar News Agency/i.test(String(x.sourceName || '')); })
        .map(function(x){ return {title:normalizeFeedTitle(x.title), link:String(x.link || '')}; })
        .filter(function(item){ return item.title && !isBoringInstitutionalHealthHeadline(item.title); })
        .slice(0,12);

      const ajProxy = currentItems
        .filter(function(x){ return /Al Jazeera/i.test(String(x.sourceName || '')); })
        .map(function(x){ return {title:normalizeFeedTitle(x.title), link:String(x.link || '')}; })
        .filter(function(item){ return item.title; })
        .slice(0,12);

      if (qnaProxy.length) {
        rotasticQnaHeadlines = qnaProxy;
        Storage.setJSON('rotastic_cached_qna_headlines', rotasticQnaHeadlines);
      }
      if (ajProxy.length) {
        rotasticAlJazeeraHeadlines = ajProxy;
        Storage.setJSON('rotastic_cached_aljazeera_headlines', rotasticAlJazeeraHeadlines);
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {}

  try {
    const aaItems=await fetchRssJson(alArabiyaEndpoint);
    rotasticAlArabiyaHeadlines=aaItems.map(function(x){return {title:normalizeFeedTitle(x.title),link:String(x.link||x.url||'')};}).filter(function(x){return x.title;}).slice(0,15);
    if(rotasticAlArabiyaHeadlines.length) Storage.setJSON('rotastic_cached_alarabiya_headlines',rotasticAlArabiyaHeadlines);
  } catch(e){rotasticAlArabiyaHeadlines=Storage.getJSON('rotastic_cached_alarabiya_headlines',[])||[];}

  try {
    const medicalItems = await fetchRssJson(medicalEndpoint);
    rotasticLatestMedicalHeadlines = medicalItems
      .map(function(x){ return normalizeFeedTitle(x.title); })
      .filter(Boolean)
      .slice(0,12);

    if (rotasticLatestMedicalHeadlines.length) {
      Storage.setJSON('rotastic_cached_medica

---
    .slice(0,15);
    if (rotasticReutersHeadlines.length) {
      Storage.setJSON('rotastic_cached_reuters_headlines', rotasticReutersHeadlines);
    }
  } catch (e) {
    rotasticReutersHeadlines = Storage.getJSON('rotastic_cached_reuters_headlines', []) || [];
  }

  try {
    const nhsItems = await fetchRssJson(nhsEndpoint);
    rotasticNhsHeadlines = nhsItems
      .map(function(x){ return {title:normalizeFeedTitle(x.title), link:String(x.link || x.url || '')}; })
      .filter(function(item) {
        return item.title && /(guideline|guidance|trial|study|evidence|recommend|screening|diabet|hypertens|obes|cancer|renal|kidney|cardiovascular|antimicrobial|antibiotic|vaccin|asthma|copd|thyroid|medicine|treatment)/i.test(item.title);
      })
      .slice(0,12);
    if (rotasticNhsHeadlines.length) Storage.setJSON('rotastic_cached_nhs_headlines', rotasticNhsHeadlines);
  } catch (e) {
    rotasticNhsHeadlines = Storage.getJSON('rotastic_cached_nhs_headlines', []) || [];
  }
}

function makeShortMedicalHeadline(title, sourceName) {
  const raw = String(title || '')
    .replace(/\s+-\s+Google News\s*$/i, '')
    .replace(/\s+-\s+(NICE|Medscape|JAMA|NEJM|The Lancet|BMJ|Sidra Medicine|Hamad Medical Corporation)\s*$/i, '')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim();
  const direct = fitNormalTickerCopy(raw, 15, 108);
  if (direct) return direct;
  const t = raw.toLowerCase();
  const rules = [
    [/meningococcal/, 'Meningococcal disease: recognition, treatment and prevention'],
    [/microbiome/, 'Microbiome research may reshape future therapies'],
    [/(glp-?1|tirzepatide)/, 'New GLP-1 evidence relevant to primary care'],
    [/diabet.*renal|renal.*diabet/, 'Diabetes care: protect cardiovascular and renal health'],
    [/obes|weight loss|weight management/, 'New evidence in obesity treatment and weight management'],
    [/hypertens|blood pressure/, 'New evidence in hypertension diagnosis and treatment'],
    [/asthma/, 'New evidence in asthma diagnosis and treatment'],
    [/(copd|chronic obstructive)/, 'New evidence in COPD management'],
    [/sepsis/, 'Updated sepsis recognition and management guidance'],
    [/vaccin|immunis|immuniz/, 'New evidence in vaccination practice'],
    [/antibiotic|antimicrobial/, 'New antimicrobial prescribing evidence'],
    [/mental health|depress|anxiety/, 'New evidence in primary-care mental health'],
    [/screening/, 'New evidence in screening practice'],
    [/thyroid/, 'New evidence in thyroid diagnosis and management'],
    [/family medicine|primary care|general practice/, 'New evidence relevant to family medicine'],
    [/clinical trial|randomi[sz]ed trial/, 'Important new clinical trial relevant to primary care'],
    [/guideline|guidance/, 'Important new clinical guidance for primary care']
  ];
  for (const rule of rules) if (rule[0].test(t)) return fitNormalTickerCopy(rule[1], 15, 108);
  return '';
}

function chooseLatestMedicalHeadline() {
  rotasticCurrentMedicalLink = '';

  let regional = rotasticRegionalMedicalHeadlines;

  if (!regional.length) {
    regional =
      Storage.getJSON('rotastic_cached_regional_medical_headlines', []) || [];
  }

  // Prefer Qatar / Arab-region clinical news strongly.
  if (regional.length) {
    const top = regional.slice(0, Math.min(regional.length, 20));
    const totalWeight = top.reduce(function(sum, item) {
      return sum + Math.max(1, Number(item.priority || 1));
    }, 0);

    let pick = Math.random() * totalWeight;
    let chosen = top[0];

    for (const item of top) {
      pick -= Math.max(1, Number(item.priority || 1));
      if (pick <= 0) {
        chosen = item;
        break;
      }
    }

    rotasticCurrentMedicalSourceMeta = {
      name:chosen.sourceName,
      domain:chosen.domain
    };
    // Avoid repeating a recently shown medical headline/summary.
    const candidates = top.filter(function(item) {
      const summary = makeShortMedicalHeadline(item.title, item.sourceName);
      return summary && !rotasticRecentMedicalHeadlines.includes(summary);
    });
    if (candidates.length) {
      chosen = candidates[Math.floor(Math.random() * candidates.length)];
      rotasticCurrentMedicalSourceMeta = {name:chosen.sourceName, domain:chosen.domain};
    }
    rotasticCurrentMedicalLink = String(chosen.link || '');

    const summary = makeShortMedicalHeadline(chosen.title, chosen.sourceName);
    if (summary) {
      rotasticRecentMedicalHeadlines.push(summary);
      if (rotasticRecentMedicalHeadlines.length > 6) rotasticRecentMedicalHeadlines.shift();
    }
    return summary;
  }

  const pool = rotasticLatestMedicalHeadlines.length
    ? rotasticLatestMedicalHeadlines
    : (
        rotasticLiveClinicalUpdates.length
          ? rotasticLiveClinicalUpdates
          : []
      );

  if (pool.length) {
    const headline = pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * Math.min(pool.length, 6))];

    rotasticCurrentMedicalSourceMeta = {
      name:'Google News medical feed',
      domain:'news.google.com'
    };

    return '🩺 ' + makeShortMedicalHeadline(headline, 'Medical News');
  }

  // Never leave the MEDICAL slot empty. This is explicitly a source landing
  // page, not a fabricated article headline.
  const fallback =
    ROTASTIC_MEDICAL_SOURCE_FALLBACKS[
      Math.floor(Math.random() * ROTASTIC_MEDICAL_SOURCE_FALLBACKS.length)
    ];

  rotasticCurrentMedicalSourceMeta = {
    name:fallback.sourceName,
    domain:fallback.domain
  };
  rotasticCurrentMedicalLink = fallback.link;

  return makeShortMedicalHeadline(fallback.title, fallback.sourceName);
}

function getActualDohaWeatherTickerText() {
  const weather = readCachedDohaWeather();
  if (!weather || typeof weather.temp !== 'number') return '';
  const label = String(weather.label || 'current conditions').toLowerCase();
  return 'Doha now: ' + Math.round(weather.temp) + '°C, ' + label + '.';
}

function makeShortNewsHeadline(title) {
  const raw = String(title || '')
    .replace(/\s+-\s+(Reuters|Al Jazeera|Qatar News Agency|QNA|

---
x = rotasticSafePracticeBag.shift();
  rotasticSafeAdviceIndex = index;
  return ROTASTIC_SAFE_PRACTICE_ADVICE[index];
}


function nextDoctorEncouragement() {
  if (!ROTASTIC_DOCTOR_ENCOURAGEMENT.length) return '';
  if (!rotasticEncouragementBag.length) {
    rotasticEncouragementBag = rotasticRefillShuffleBag(
      ROTASTIC_DOCTOR_ENCOURAGEMENT.length,
      rotasticEncouragementIndex
    );
  }
  const index = rotasticEncouragementBag.shift();
  rotasticEncouragementIndex = index;
  return ROTASTIC_DOCTOR_ENCOURAGEMENT[index];
}

function fitNormalTickerCopy(value, maxWords, maxChars) {
  const text = String(value || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  if (!text || text.includes('…') || text.includes('...')) return '';
  const words = text.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  if (words.length > Number(maxWords || 16)) return '';
  if (text.length > Number(maxChars || 112)) return '';
  return text;
}

function getTickerCopySizeClass(message) {
  const text = String(message || '').trim();
  const words = text.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length;
  if (words <= 8 && text.length <= 58) return 'ticker-copy-short';
  if (words <= 12 && text.length <= 86) return 'ticker-copy-medium';
  return 'ticker-copy-long';
}

function conciseTickerText(value, maxChars) {
  const text = String(value || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  const max = Math.max(58, Number(maxChars || 92));
  if (text.length <= max) return text;
  return '';
}

function getPrayerTickerMessage(prayerTimes) {
  return choosePrayerMessage(prayerTimes) || '';
}

function nextQatarFunFact() {
  const value = ROTASTIC_QATAR_FUN_FACTS[rotasticQatarFactIndex % ROTASTIC_QATAR_FUN_FACTS.length];
  rotasticQatarFactIndex = (rotasticQatarFactIndex + 1) % ROTASTIC_QATAR_FUN_FACTS.length;
  return value;
}

function getInjectedRegionalMedicalStats() {
  return Array.isArray(window.ROTASTIC_REGIONAL_MEDICAL_STATS)
    ? window.ROTASTIC_REGIONAL_MEDICAL_STATS.filter(function(x){ return x && x.text; })
    : [];
}

function chooseWeightedMedicalStat() {
  const regional = getInjectedRegionalMedicalStats().map(function(x) {
    const country = String(x.country || '').trim();
    let weight = Number(x.weight || 1);
    if (/qatar/i.test(country)) weight = Math.max(weight, 8);
    else if (/saudi|uae|oman|kuwait|bahrain|jordan|lebanon|syria|iraq|pakistan/i.test(country)) weight = Math.max(weight, 3);
    else if (/uk|united kingdom|england/i.test(country)) weight = Math.max(weight, 2);
    return {country:country, weight:weight, text:String(x.text)};
  });

  const sourcePool = ROTASTIC_MEDICAL_STATS.concat(regional).filter(function(item){
    return item && String(item.text || '').trim();
  });
  if (!sourcePool.length) return '';

  // Build a fresh weighted shuffle bag only after the previous one is exhausted.
  if (!rotasticMedicalStatBag.length) {
    const weighted = [];
    sourcePool.forEach(function(item, sourceIndex) {
      for (let i=0; i<Math.max(1, Math.round(item.weight || 1)); i++) weighted.push(sourceIndex);
    });
    for (let i=weighted.length-1; i>0; i--) {
      const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));
      const tmp=weighted[i]; weighted[i]=weighted[j]; weighted[j]=tmp;
    }
    // De-duplicate adjacent copies caused by weighting while preserving weighting overall.
    const ordered=[];
    weighted.forEach(function(idx){
      if (!ordered.length || ordered[ordered.length-1] !== idx) ordered.push(idx);
    });
    // Ensure every unique stat gets a chance before repeats dominate.
    const uniques=sourcePool.map(function(_,i){return i;}).filter(function(i){return !ordered.includes(i);});
    r

---
icRefillShuffleBag(
      ROTASTIC_DOCTOR_ENCOURAGEMENT.length,
      rotasticEncouragementIndex
    );
  }
  const index = rotasticEncouragementBag.shift();
  rotasticEncouragementIndex = index;
  return ROTASTIC_DOCTOR_ENCOURAGEMENT[index];
}

function fitNormalTickerCopy(value, maxWords, maxChars) {
  const text = String(value || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  if (!text || text.includes('…') || text.includes('...')) return '';
  const words = text.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  if (words.length > Number(maxWords || 16)) return '';
  if (text.length > Number(maxChars || 112)) return '';
  return text;
}

function getTickerCopySizeClass(message) {
  const text = String(message || '').trim();
  const words = text.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length;
  if (words <= 8 && text.length <= 58) return 'ticker-copy-short';
  if (words <= 12 && text.length <= 86) return 'ticker-copy-medium';
  return 'ticker-copy-long';
}

function conciseTickerText(value, maxChars) {
  const text = String(value || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  const max = Math.max(58, Number(maxChars || 92));
  if (text.length <= max) return text;
  return '';
}

  '🇶🇦 Doha’s Corniche stretches along the city’s waterfront.',
  '🇶🇦 The oryx is an important national symbol in Qatar.'
];

let rotasticQatarFactIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * ROTASTIC_QATAR_FUN_FACTS.length);
let rotasticMedicalStatCycleCount = 0;

function nextQatarFunFact() {
  const value = ROTASTIC_QATAR_FUN_FACTS[rotasticQatarFactIndex % ROTASTIC_QATAR_FUN_FACTS.length];
  rotasticQatarFactIndex = (rotasticQatarFactIndex + 1) % ROTASTIC_QATAR_FUN_FACTS.length;
  return value;
}

function getInjectedRegionalMedicalStats() {
  return Array.isArray(window.ROTASTIC_REGIONAL_MEDICAL_STATS)
    ? window.ROTASTIC_REGIONAL_MEDICAL_STATS.filter(function(x){ return x && x.text; })
    : [];
}

function chooseWeightedMedicalStat() {
  const regional = getInjectedRegionalMedicalStats().map(function(x) {
    const country = String(x.country || '').trim();
    let weight = Number(x.weight || 1);
    if (/qatar/i.test(country)) weight = Math.max(weight, 8);
    else if (/saudi|uae|oman|kuwait|bahrain|jordan|lebanon|syria|iraq|pakistan/i.test(country)) weight = Math.max(weight, 3);
    else if (/uk|united kingdom|england/i.test(country)) weight = Math.max(weight, 2);
    return {country:country, weight:weight, text:String(x.text)};
  });

  const sourcePool = ROTASTIC_MEDICAL_STATS.concat(regional).filter(function(item){
    return item && String(item.text || '').trim();
  });
  if (!sourcePool.length) return '';

  // Build a fresh weighted shuffle bag only after the previous one is exhausted.
  if (!rotasticMedicalStatBag.length) {
    const weighted = [];
    sourcePool.forEach(function(item, sourceIndex) {
      for (let i=0; i<Math.max(1, Math.round(item.weight || 1)); i++) weighted.push(sourceIndex);
    });
    for (let i=weighted.length-1; i>0; i--) {
      const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));
      const tmp=weighted[i]; weighted[i]=weighted[j]; weighted[j]=tmp;
    }
    // De-duplicate adjacent copies caused by weighting while preserving weighting overall.
    const ordered=[];
    weighted.forEach(function(idx){
      if (!ordered.length || ordered[ordered.length-1] !== idx) ordered.push(idx);
    });
    // Ensure every unique stat gets a chance before repeats dominate.
    const uniques=sourcePool.map(function(_,i){return i;}).filter(function(i){return !ordered.includes(i);});
    rotasticMedicalStatBag = ordered.concat(uniques);
  }

  const index = rotasticMedicalStatBag.shift();
  return String(sourcePool[index] && sourcePool[index].text || '').trim();
}
